title: 3/9 redesignated 2/5 under McPartlin

paragraphs.text: The Third Battalion, Ninth Marines was redesignated the Second Battalion, Fifth Marines. Lieutenant Colonel C. E. MC PARTLIN, Jr., was the Commanding Officer.
